name: Enneagram Type Screening Inventory (36 items)
description: 36-item screening inventory mapping respondents to the nine Enneagram personality types as described by Riso & Hudson. Four items per type, each capturing a core motivation, fear, or behavioral signature of that type. Note: this is a constructed screening instrument for research use, not a validated clinical assessment. Type with highest mean score is the candidate primary type; second-highest is candidate wing.
citation: Riso, D. R., & Hudson, R. (1999). The wisdom of the Enneagram. Bantam. (Items constructed for this study based on widely-used Enneagram type descriptions.)
license: Items written for this study — CC-BY for the item set.

items.text: I have a strong inner sense of what is right and wrong, and I feel responsible for upholding it.
I often notice flaws and mistakes that others overlook, and I feel compelled to correct them.
I work hard to improve myself and live up to high standards.
I sometimes feel quietly angry or resentful when people aren't doing things the right way.
I genuinely enjoy taking care of others and anticipating their needs.
I find it difficult to ask for help or say what I need from others.
People often turn to me when they need emotional support.
I feel best about myself when I am needed or appreciated by others.
I am highly driven to achieve and be successful in my work.
I am very conscious of how I am perceived by others, and I adjust my image accordingly.
I am efficient and adaptable; I can shift roles to fit what the situation requires.
I find it hard to slow down or stop working — being productive is core to who I am.
I feel that I am fundamentally different from other people in some essential way.
I am drawn to what is missing, melancholic, or aesthetically meaningful.
My emotional life is deep and intense, and I value authentic self-expression.
I sometimes envy what others have that I feel I am lacking.
I prefer to observe and analyze a situation thoroughly before participating.
I value my privacy and need significant time alone to recharge.
I find deep satisfaction in mastering complex subjects and acquiring expertise.
I conserve my energy and resources, and I'm uncomfortable when others demand too much of me.
I am alert to potential threats and tend to anticipate what could go wrong.
I value loyalty and commitment, and I'm dependable in my relationships.
I often seek reassurance or guidance from people or systems I trust.
I question authority and motives — sometimes my own — more than most people do.
I am drawn to new experiences, options, and possibilities; I dislike feeling limited.
I tend to reframe difficult situations in a positive or hopeful light.
I prefer to keep my options open rather than commit to one path.
I have a hard time staying with painful or boring experiences for very long.
I am direct, decisive, and unafraid to confront people when needed.
I take charge of situations naturally and protect those under my care.
Showing vulnerability or weakness is difficult for me.
When I feel disrespected or controlled, I respond with intensity.
I value harmony and tend to avoid conflict when possible.
I am easy-going and can see most situations from multiple perspectives.
I sometimes lose track of my own priorities by going along with what others want.
I prefer comfort and routine to disruption and intensity.
